descriptions.w3d_d24e_register_volume_button_properti: Resets the ResourceName string binding (0x801ed24c) to the shared empty string; resets the HighlightedMessage string binding (0x801ed24c) to the shared empty string; resets the SelectedMessage string binding (0x801ed24c) to the shared empty string; sets the BorderResource string binding (0x801ed24c) to a temporary string made from "FE.Button.%s" (0x803b61f8, constructor 0x8020bb54); registers BorderColour (0x801ece2c); registers SquareButton (0x801eb674); registers BorderBehind (0x801eb674); registers MinOffset (0x801ec52c); registers MaxOffset (0x801ec52c); resets the VolumeId string binding (0x801ed24c) to the shared empty string; resets the AudioData string binding (0x801ed24c) to the shared empty string; calls the refresh routine 0x801e8d9c and returns 0.
